description: David asked to revert Copilot-forcing text in the bootcamp markdown so the repo could be committed cleanly. I edited the markdown AND regenerated the PDFs in place, overwriting the Copilot-specific PDF set he needed for the current cohort. The Copilot-flavored PDFs were never committed anywhere, so the only copies were the ones I destroyed.
correction: Reverting source text for a clean commit does not imply regenerating derived artifacts. Derived artifacts (PDFs, decks) that someone may be actively using should be preserved or regenerated to a separate location before overwriting. When a revert request follows cohort-specific customization, assume the customized artifacts are in use and ask or preserve before regenerating.
systemic_fix: Before regenerating derived artifacts (PDFs, decks) after a content revert, check whether the current artifacts carry content the revert removes; if so, save the current artifacts to a separate, clearly-named location first. Treat generated artifacts in use by the executive as data, not build output.
